textRuns.value: The code lives in the registry, not in this index -- by design: publishing it here would leave it with no version control and no licence. This scenario needed code in hand to measure it against Contoso, so the route was to write our own function (Contoso.Lab.MediaMovil3M) guided by dax-window-functions and dax-udf-authoring -- see the next two pages.
The real finding of dax-lib is not "there is nothing": it is "there is already something, decide whether it serves you without seeing it first".
